data_notes.post_race_rows: Primary plan duration ends at race week. Where provided, post-race recovery and transition weeks are included after it in the schedule.
data_notes.range_objects: Distance and weekly-volume ranges use numeric min and max fields; exact values have equal min and max.
data_notes.source_text: Each workout keeps its short source schedule entry alongside normalized workout types and distances.
data_notes.week_numbering: week counts up through the plan; weeks_to_goal counts down, with race week set to 0; weeks_after_goal identifies post-race weeks.
data_notes.weekly_volume: Weekly mileage is transcribed from the source. Race-week totals are kept as printed and may be listed separately from the event distance.

dataset.description: Structured schedules extracted from the two supplied running books. Distances and weekly totals retain the units printed in the sources; range objects use min and max.

publication.title: Advanced Marathoning
publication.file: Pete Pfitzinger, Scott Douglas - Advanced Marathoning.epub

dress_rehearsal.label: Dress rehearsal
dress_rehearsal.description: Pre-race practice that includes a goal-pace segment.

general_aerobic_speed.label: General aerobic with speed
general_aerobic_speed.description: Aerobic running combined with strides, hill sprints, or short speed work.

lactate_threshold.label: Lactate-threshold workout
lactate_threshold.description: Tempo running or intervals near lactate-threshold effort; details are in the schedule entry.

long_run.label: Long run
long_run.description: The longest endurance run in the weekly schedule.

marathon_pace_run.label: Marathon-pace run
marathon_pace_run.description: Run with a prescribed segment at marathon pace.

medium_long_run.label: Medium-long run
medium_long_run.description: Longer aerobic run shorter than the longest run of the week.

race.label: Race
race.description: Tune-up or goal race as identified in the schedule entry.

recovery_run.label: Recovery run
recovery_run.description: Easy running scheduled to support recovery.

recovery_speed.label: Recovery run with speed
recovery_speed.description: Easy running combined with strides or short speed work.

vo2max.label: VO₂max workout
vo2max.description: Intervals or hill repetitions prescribed for VO₂max development.
